newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SPR oil awards, if any, due later Thursday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SPR oil awards, if any, due later Thursday.

text.p: The U.S. government is expected to announce awards, if any, Thursday afternoon in the first round of its latest auction from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, an Energy Department official said.
Best and final offers are due at 1300 EDT.

The Energy Department is offering up to 15 million barrels of light sour crude and 370,000 barrels of sweet crude to raise $220 million to pay for running the emergency oil reserve during the current fiscal year, which began October 1.
